policy.headline: An update every two to three weeks, on a Saturday. Fixes come when they're ready.
points: Updates come every two to three weeks, always on a Saturday. The next dates are listed below, so you can see what's coming and when.
New features are finished by the Wednesday before. Thursday and Friday are for testing, including on a real Windows PC.
Fix releases: when needed, usually within a week of a confirmed bug.
Anything that could lose your data is fixed as fast as possible, often the same day.
If an update isn't ready or hasn't been tested properly, it moves to the next date instead of shipping. This page says so and why.
The browser version (the website) updates as soon as a release is published. The browser zip is attached to every release.
Windows and Linux get silent updates in version 1.3.2. On a Mac the app tells you when an update is out and links to the download, because Apple's signing isn't paid for yet.
notified: Press Watch on the GitHub page, then Custom, then Releases, to get an email for each release.
Add the releases feed to your feed reader.
In the desktop app, Control Panel shows when it last checked for updates and what it found.

upcoming.title: Clipy makes things, and tidier pop-outs
items: Clipy can create events, reminders, tasks and assignments when you ask
A switch to also write what Clipy makes to Apple Calendar (Mac)
Clipy's tips and fun facts stop coming back to back
Pop-out windows: no desktop strip at the bottom, a matching title bar on Windows, and File > Pop Out App to open any app in its own window
Browser version: the storage bar shows the real limit in every browser
upcoming.note: Needs testing on a real Windows PC before it ships.

upcoming.title: Silent updates for Windows and Linux
items: Silent auto-update for Windows and Linux (Mac stays notify-and-download)
A few smaller improvements will be added here as they're confirmed
upcoming.note: Windows is tested on a real PC. Linux can only be tested in a virtual environment, so Linux updating is best effort.

upcoming.title: Stability release
items: No new features: fixes, testing and making things more reliable
Testing on Mac, Windows and Linux

items: Still on the list, with no date yet: Now Playing covers on Windows that check every media session.
The plan for this one is posted here once 1.4 is out.

released.summary: Write to Apple Calendar and Reminders (Mac), pop-out windows for apps, Apple's on-device model for M.X.E.S., optional Now Playing cover lookup, and loading your desktop backup in the browser.
Important fix: saved data wasn't read after updating if you had folders or structured citations.
Windows fixes: full screen, tougher saving, an optional taskbar number, a taskbar menu, and troubleshooting buttons.
Command palette, tags and courses, folders as course hubs, shortcuts you can change, and a better update checker.
Citation Maker 2.0, Sketch Pad 2.0, a flash-card hotkey, and Now Playing in the taskbar clock.
Apple Calendar and Reminders (reading), Periodic Table 2.0, and a calendar in the taskbar clock.
